units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:5">Bets. V, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 4:7">Tosef. ib. IV, 7</cite> <he>הג׳ כרגלי וכ׳</he> if one takes burning coals from his neighbor on the Holy day, they may be carried only as far as the owner is permitted to go; contrad. to <cite ref="U01219"><he>שלהבת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:6:4">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵇ</cite> bot.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:14">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>כניצוץ מבעיר ג׳</he> (as dangerous) as a spark kindling coals.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>והוי זהיר בגַחַלְתָּן וכ׳</he> take care of their (the scholars’) burning coals (do not treat them lightly) that thou mayest not be burnt.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78:15">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> end <he>שלא נִכָּוֶה בגַחַלְתּוֹ וכ׳</he> (we are afraid) that we may be burnt by the coal of Jacob, i.e. come to grief through contact with a godly man.—Pl. <he>גֶּחָלִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51:2">Gen. R. s. 51</cite> <he>רדת ג׳</he> she took coals out of the oven; a. fr.
